tasks.prompt: Create a new agent skill named release-notes. Create release-notes/SKILL.md with valid YAML frontmatter containing the name release-notes and a clear description. Add instructions explaining how to summarize commits into release notes, group changes into Added, Changed and Fixed sections, and avoid inventing changes.

contracts.desc: A new SKILL.md file was created

descI18n.ja: SKILL.md ファイルが作成された

contracts.desc: The skill has the correct name

descI18n.ja: スキルに説明が含まれている

contracts.desc: The instructions name the Added, Changed and Fixed sections

descI18n.zh: 说明中列出了 Added、Changed 和 Fixed 三个分类
descI18n.ja: 説明に Added・Changed・Fixed の区分が含まれている

contracts.desc: SKILL.md starts with a closed YAML frontmatter block that holds the name

descI18n.zh: SKILL.md 以闭合的 YAML 前置元数据开头并包含名称
descI18n.ja: SKILL.md は名前を含む閉じた YAML フロントマターで始まる

contracts.desc: The description says when to use the skill ("Use when ...")

descI18n.zh: 描述说明了何时使用该技能
descI18n.ja: 説明にいつ使うかが書かれている
